en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Muhgammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about Zi Al-Faqar, the sword of Rasool-Allahsaww, from where is it?’ Heasws said: ‘Jibraeelas descended with it from the sky, and its sheath was of silver, and it is with measws’.
en.sarwar: 5. hmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya have narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abdallah who has said that he asked abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.)
about al-Dhulfaqar, the sword of the Messenger of Allah as to wherefrom it was. The Imam (a.s.) said, “Jibril came down with it from the heavens. It was decorated with gold and it is with me now.”
